limits: Full Swift XCTest is not claimed by the standalone probes; local missing-XCTest failures are retained and CI remains a separate result.
Small generated raster fixtures and about ten minutes bound the endurance evidence; not an unlimited-history, leak-free, physical-screen or UI-latency certification.
Process sampling observes uncontrolled running activity; not an idle or leak certification. ps CPU is not treated as an exact per-interval measurement.
Ownership child uses a 0.5-second readiness window. Extreme scheduling delay can cause a false failure; the observed successful lock-conflict/reacquisition cases remain valid.
Previously accepted real Beta evidence is cited with its source and software-CGEvent scope; this review performed no new upload, send or production data write.
The phrase runtimeSourceUnchangedFrom in WP02-results is interpreted only for the tested Core/Capture/Adapters/Web paths, not the three wording changes or the unintegrated settings foundation.
Developer ID/notarization/Gatekeeper, new-user OS prompts, true display/Spaces/wake and native accessibility/IME acceptance remain explicit outside this preparation review.

resolvedFindings.problem: Original burst timing began after file generation and awaited restart scan.

resolvedFindings.problem: Process CPU accumulation and second-probe elapsed time had different origins.
resolvedFindings.resolution: Current key is processCPUSeconds; long-run percentage recomputed from first-to-last CPU and elapsed increments, matching summary.

resolvedFindings.problem: Diagnostic default wording did not distinguish a new draft from reopening an existing opted-in draft.
resolvedFindings.resolution: Privacy documentation now states fresh-draft default OFF and retained same-draft choice, matching FeedbackWindowController.applyDraft.

resolvedFindings.problem: Non-PNG/JPEG support wording omitted the oversized-derived-PNG original-file fallback.
resolvedFindings.resolution: README, SUPPORT and supportText now describe usual PNG rendition plus the existing one-attempt original-file fallback and page-compatibility limit.

resolvedFindings.resolution: Actual monotonic elapsed, requested time and process identity are recorded; archived missing-PID result is structured incomplete JSON.
